issues.issue: The transfer goes into a Water fund, which is normally a business-type utility fund. Because the form is a single Total All Funds page, the Water fund's receipts and spending (if any) are mixed into the governmental lines. Someone needs to decide whether SID 4 has a business-type water utility and whether this is really a governmental-to-business-type transfer. decision_needed[] has no entry for this.
